thread:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a small UX change: allow teams to set a "default view" per-route in Console analytics. Current problem: product folks always reapply the same filters when they jump between routes. Proposal: a lightweight "Set as route default" that stores a saved filter scoped to the route (not global).

kevin: +1 on the ergonomics. Question: do we store this as a saved filter object or as a pointer to the current UI state?

maria: I think a saved_filter entity (id + json state) is cleaner — easier to share and audit. But it must have a scope field: {"scope":"route","route_id":"..."} vs "org".

samir: Heads-up about telemetry ingestion: if we allow arbitrary tag filters as defaults (e.g., quota_tag, customer_tier) we risk exploding cardinality. We should restrict route defaults to low-cardinality tag keys and validate on save. :warning:

alex: Good call. From infra side, we should enforce a whitelist at the API level and surface validation errors in the UI: "Cannot set as default — tag key has too many distinct values."

jess: UX detail: make the UI path simple — current filter bar -> three-dot menu -> "Make default for this route" -> confirmation modal that lists scope and who can change it. Leave an undo. :thumbsup:

lina: Permissioning note: only route owners + org admins should be allowed to set route defaults. Otherwise teams will stomp on each other. Also show who created the default in the header.

kevin: Policy question: should a route default override an org default? my vote: yes, route default takes precedence when present, fallback to org default otherwise.

maria: Agreed. Implementation idea: when rendering a route page, query: GET /api/console/saved_filters?scope=route&route_id=R || GET ...?scope=org&org_id=O and merge. Keep logic server-side so clients stay thin.

samir: Implementation caveat: we sample telemetry. The UI expects stable metric ordering. If sampling changes, people might think the default broke. We should persist the filters only; don't bake sampled thresholds. Also include a short note in the modal: "Filters are independent of telemetry sampling." :information_source:

alex: API shape suggestion (draft):
```
POST /api/console/saved_filters
{
  "name": "Errors + p95 - mobile",
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "route_123",
  "filter_state": { /* serialized UI state */ },
  "pinned": true
}
```
Return 400 if tag key not allowed.

jess: Another UX requirement: let users pin multiple saved filters per route (e.g., "Quick ops" and "Cost view") but have one default. So UI should show "Set as default" next to each saved filter and indicate which one is active.

maria: On retention: saved filters should be lightweight strings + json, but add soft-delete and audit log entry (who set/unset default + timestamp). We need this for support tickets.

lina: Ops ask: show the default setting in telemetry router docs — customers expect the Console URL to reflect the filters so they can bookmark. Make sure we canonicalize URLs: /console/routes/route_123?saved_filter=sf_987

kevin: Edge case: if a route is cloned, should defaults copy? I'd say yes if the team explicitly selects "copy defaults" during clone. Otherwise it's surprising.

samir: Scaling concern: if many routes each have defaults, list endpoints need to be efficient. Use join table and index on route_id, and avoid pulling filter_state in route listing endpoints. Only fetch when route page is opened.

alex: For rollout: feature flag + gradual enable per org. We'll need a migration to add "scope" to existing saved_filters. Small migration but set org-scoped default for pre-existing items.

jess: Can we add a small CTA in the Console: "Set this view as default for your route" — soft launch in beta orgs. I'll design microcopy.

maria: Plan: I'll push a small API PR with validation + migration draft, alex + samir to review infra impacts, jess to mock UX, lina to update docs. Target: ship to beta orgs next sprint.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: deployment queued for infra/console/saved-filters validation (canary 10%) — 1835679140.

kevin: One last thought — allow toggle: "make this default for everyone vs only for me"? Might be confusing. Let's keep it org/route scope for now and revisit personal defaults later. :thinking_face:

maria: Agreed. Thanks everyone — I'll open the GH issue and link prototypes here. :eyes:
